about_the_game:
Mage & Maze is a 2D puzzle dungeon crawler packed with humor and challenges.

You control a clumsy wizard trapped in a dungeon where every step matters.

Your only tool is a magical staff that can push and pull objects, activate mechanisms, and manipulate enemies to clear the way to the exit.

Grid-Based Puzzles: Every move consumes mana, and the challenge is to finish with the fewest steps possible.

Versatile Magic Staff: Move boxes, push enemies, and activate traps to your advantage.

Comedic Enemies: Rats, spiders, ghosts, and even mimics — all part of the puzzle.

A Dungeon of Interconnected Rooms: From simple introductions to challenging combinations of mechanics.

Test your creativity, plan every move, and find out just how far your bumbling magic can take you!
